summary: Code review complete. Minimal documentation-only change to APICacheManager::invalidateMethod() docblock.

The @throws APICacheException annotation is factually correct: invalidateMethod() calls getMethodCacheFolder() which throws APICacheException(ERROR_INVALID_METHOD_NAME) on empty or path-traversal-containing method names. Since invalidateMethod() has no catch block, the exception propagates to the caller. The annotation precisely reflects runtime behavior.

Also verified in scope: getMethodCacheFolder() path validation guards are sound (empty, /, .., DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR) and the security trust model is properly documented in the @param comment. No issues found.
